No regression.

CRIT-104's reuse guarantee holds: NOTE_PUBLISH_SCRIPT (the existing ai-entity-article-writer pipeline) is still called, now only for the 'verify' subcommand; the old membership-hardcoded 'publish' subcommand call is gone (confirmed absent by tests/test-prop21-visual-and-single-price.sh:52).

note_mcp.api.articles.create_draft is imported and called directly (not reimplemented), matching PROP-20/CRIT-104's 'never rebuilt' requirement; grep 'create_draft' also matches lib/note_publish.sh's own comment at line 31, so the passThreshold's literal grep oracle is satisfiable.
CRIT-105's real-article check holds: no 'burn 10+ hours' boilerplate marker found; a '## 出典' section exists listing real https:// URLs (x402.org, docs.x402.org).

Both post-PROP-21-fix screenshot artifacts CRIT-105 designates (for the SECOND draft, key nfb2ace9f0ed8, distinct from the flagged pre-fix n7261a753887f draft) exist on disk, confirmed via direct filesystem glob.
